q: Which PivotTable area holds the categories listed vertically?
why: Fields in Rows are displayed vertically.

q: A PivotTable counts PatientID 120 times, but only 85 unique patients exist. Why?
why: Count counts nonblank rows, not distinct patients.

q: Which chart is usually appropriate for a time trend?
why: A line chart is appropriate for ordered time intervals.

q: Why should a KPI chart show numerator and denominator?
why: A percentage alone can obscure the sample size.

q: What must happen after adding rows to a PivotTable source?
why: Refresh the PivotTable and confirm the source includes the new records.
